description: Deliberate test (failing_deploy_rolls_back): Deploy an api revision that runs but never serves, so it fails the load balancer's health checks; the deployment circuit breaker must roll the service back to the prior revision. The test revision is deregistered after. The newest recorded run must have passed within 30 days

matrix_rows.gap: Run once per environment session and recorded (cadence 30 days), not every 3: the environment it needs stands only during sessions.
Tested per stage where a test exists: the deploy stage, by a revision that fails its health checks. The image signing and verification stage has no deliberate failing test.
